t: Markdown Document Generator - Signature build-tool concept
title: Markdown Document Generator - Signature build-tool concept
definition: Produces structured Markdown documentation.
description:
Every build an AI undertakes passes through Markdown Document Generator: Produces structured Markdown documentation. The catalog lists it among the thousand fundamental build tools because no serious building happens without it. This database is its Signature edition - the concept rebuilt as a deterministic framework with seven pillars, grounded in real techniques and standards, and taught through a ladder of runnable drills.

The Signature line treats Markdown Document Generator as infrastructure, not inspiration. Infrastructure has contracts: given these inputs, in this state, the Markdown Document Generator produces that output, and anyone can verify it. The seven pillars are those contracts made concrete - each owns one responsibility, each can be tested alone, and together they compose into the full capability. The technique records show the real public knowledge the pillars stand on.

Work through this database the way you would commission a machine: read the charter in the overview, inspect each pillar, check the techniques against your own knowledge, then run the drills. Every record includes a program you can execute with node - the Markdown Document Generator is demonstrated, not merely described.

t: Signature Scribe - Markdown Document Generator framework pillar
title: Signature Scribe - Markdown Document Generator framework pillar
definition: The Scribe component of the Signature Markdown Document Generator framework, owning scribe. Signature concept.
description:
The Signature Markdown Document Generator framework decomposes the capability (Produces structured Markdown documentation.) into seven pillars, and the Scribe is the one that owns the framework's scribe responsibilities. Owning a responsibility means three things in the Signature line: the pillar declares exactly what it accepts, it publishes exactly what it guarantees, and it logs enough evidence that a third party can replay its work and reach the same conclusion.

This discipline pays off when builds go wrong, because they always eventually do. When a Markdown Document Generator result looks suspicious, the auditor does not re-run the whole build and hope; they replay the Scribe's log, check its guarantees against its inputs, and find the fault at its source. The pillar is thus both a worker and a witness - it does the work and it testifies about the work.

Try it yourself: this record's demo runs the Scribe's core procedure on a worked example. The program is plain JavaScript - save it as demo.js and run it with node, or press Run in the Demo Lab. Change the inputs and re-run; the procedure is deterministic, so you can verify every claim the description makes.

Signature framing: this pillar is part of the Signature line's original design for Markdown Document Generator. It is labeled a Signature concept throughout - an engineered proposal, not an established public fact. The techniques it relies on are real and cited in the technique records of this database.

t: Signature Mapper - Markdown Document Generator framework pillar
title: Signature Mapper - Markdown Document Generator framework pillar
definition: The Mapper component of the Signature Markdown Document Generator framework, owning mapper. Signature concept.
description:
The Mapper is a load-bearing component of the Signature Markdown Document Generator framework. Its contract is narrow and absolute: within the framework, everything concerning the framework's mapper responsibilities belongs to the Mapper, and the Mapper answers for it. This separation is what makes the framework testable - the Mapper can be exercised alone, with declared inputs and checkable outputs, long before it is wired into a full build.

In operation the Mapper works like this. A build request arrives carrying the Markdown Document Generator charter (produces structured Markdown documentation.). The Mapper reads its portion of the charter, performs its transformation, and hands a verified intermediate result to the next pillar. If its checks fail, it stops the line and reports exactly what was wrong, instead of passing corruption downstream. That fail-fast discipline is the Signature line's signature.

Signature-concept illustration: a builder asks for a small docs job that needs Markdown Document Generator. The Mapper takes the request's mapper responsibilities slice, applies the framework's deterministic procedure, and returns its result with a proof of what it did.
